_comment: Wii Remote -> Dreamcast pad. The Pi hub's Wiimote bridge reports the raw physical button by name: A, B, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, PLUS, MINUS, ONE, TWO, HOME. Pluto owns the mapping HERE: 'controls' maps Wiimote button -> DC button. B (the trigger under the index finger) = A, the DC's fire button in gun games; A = B; the d-pad is the d-pad; PLUS = Start; ONE/TWO = X/Y; MINUS/HOME = the L/R shoulders. The AIM (the IR dots worked out into a screen position) is not a button: the Pi bridge sends it straight to the drive service as the 'MAIN' axis, 0..1 with 0.5 = centre and +y = up, so it is not mapped here.
